specification: Epic: Widget names are case- and whitespace-insensitive: the store keeps each name normalised (trimmed, lower-case), and a client can always look a widget up by the name it created it with, in any case or spacing. Widgets record their creation time.

findings.Message: FindByName does not normalise its input, so a client looking up a widget by the name it created it with in a different case or with surrounding whitespace (e.g. "ALPHA" or "  Alpha ") returns null, which violates the epic's requirement that lookup works in any case and spacing.
The test enshrines the case-sensitive lookup behaviour that contradicts the ticket, so it would lock in the defect and must be changed to expect the widget to be found.
